usage: 做瑜伽 is used as a verb phrase to describe the action of practicing yoga.
It can be placed after time expressions to indicate when someone does yoga, for example, '我朝早做瑜伽' means 'I do yoga in the morning.'
做瑜伽 can be combined with modal verbs like 想 (want to) or 會 (can) to express ability or desire, e.g., '我想做瑜伽' means 'I want to do yoga.'
To form negative sentences, add 唔 before 做瑜伽, such as '我唔做瑜伽' which means 'I don't do yoga.'
Questions can be made by adding the question particle 嗎 or 呢 at the end, e.g., '你做瑜伽嗎？' means 'Do you do yoga?'
